objective: Complete and make auditable the eight-floor closed-loop milestones using bounded feedback, existing Guardian execution loops, deterministic F06 operation, and independent F07 verification/remediation without creating a new authority plane.

rulesConsidered: Closed-loop architecture must remain bounded and evidence-driven.
Intelligence may propose; authority authorizes; runtime executes; evidence proves.
F07 remains independent final verification and release authority.
F06 remains deterministic operational infrastructure rather than an unrestricted cognitive agent.
No new floor topology or authority hierarchy is introduced.

forensicFindings: F00 had bounded research execution but no explicit evidence-quality feedback loop.
F04 and F05 already had GuardianEngine autonomous loops but their adapters were not exported from the Guardian package surface.
F06 had provider failover and physical artifact verification but did not expose an explicit deterministic loop receipt.
F07 generated remediation cases and invalidated downstream evidence, while re-verification was previously exercised as a caller-driven second run rather than one bounded loop contract.
The common loop substrate did not retain intermediate outputs, which would weaken remediation auditability.
